text:
ashley_infra: Quick check — VendorNimbus reports 8 standby A100s and 4 spare H100s in ap-southeast-1 for 72h window. Can we allocate an interim surge pool and who owns the billing + telemetry hook? :thinking:

mike_sre: Do we have project tags & quota for that region? also what's the expected concurrent slots / GPU mem per task?

ashley_infra: Project tag will be `redwood-demo-surge`. Expected peak ~6 concurrent slots, mostly 80GB mem usage, a couple light 40GB jobs.

tara_prod: Can we run the canary on the Llama-variant model first? want to validate perf diff when using H100 fallback. I'll need the canary prompt set.

vendor_bot: Nimbus update: "hold window" confirmed 2024-09-02T02:00Z -> 2024-09-05T02:00Z. Hold expires automatically if not claimed. Pricing note sent to procurement.

ashley_infra: Minimal CLI to claim into our demo pool (for reference):
```bash
redwoodctl pools claim --vendor=nimbus --region=ap-southeast-1 --sku=A100 --count=8 --tag=redwood-demo-surge
```

mike_sre: +1 on claiming, but will run a quick smoke at 21:00 UTC to validate networking/AMI. tagging @tara_prod for canary window. I'll also set short-lived routes so traffic goes to surge pool only for the canary.

fin_ops: Cost note: need a rough estimate before procurement sign-off. If total expected spend < $8k over window, we can approve with standard PO. Please post estimate (hours * hourly SKU rate).

ashley_infra: Estimate calc: 8 A100s * 72h * $3.10/hr ≈ $1785; 4 H100s * 72h * $6.50/hr ≈ $1872; total ≈ $3657. Adding 10% buffer ≈ $4023.

fin_ops: OK that fits. @ashley_infra open a purchase request with that estimate and include vendor quote. Make sure to put cost center RDW-INFRA-ENG.

ashley_infra: Will open PO + include vendor quote. question: who wires telemetry? we need GPU telemetry + per-request token-level traces to hook into observability.

mike_sre: I can push a short Prometheus scrape + exporter on the pool nodes. Also will add a tracing sidecar that emits trace IDs to the opentelemetry collector. I'll link the PR.

tara_prod: I'll prepare the canary prompt set and a small eval harness. plan: 100 short requests, measure p95 latency and token cost delta.

ashley_infra: Cool. Plan timeline: 20:30 UTC claim pool, 21:00 smoke tests, 21:30 canary run, 22:00 decision to keep or release.

mike_sre: Sounds good. tagging this thread for followups. I'll post smoke logs to the infra-runbook channel after 21:15. :rocket:

fin_ops: Once PO is submitted, reply here with ticket number and I'll expedite.

vendor_bot: Nimbus: quote attached to procurement ticket #NIM-4573 (internal ref).

ashley_infra: PO opened: PR-8921 (cost center RDW-INFRA-ENG). Adding vendor quote and this thread link. Will claim at 20:30 UTC.

mike_sre: Acknowledged. I'll be online for the 21:00 UTC smoke.

tara_prod: I'll be ready for canary 21:30 UTC. Leaving checks in the eval harness now.

ashley_infra: thanks all — will update with claim / smoke logs. :thumbsup:
